actions.populate: Replace the panel with count buttons, labeled Button 0 through Button count-1. Requires integer count from 1 to maxButtons.
actions.clear: Remove all buttons from the panel. No parameters.
actions.resize: Resize the app window to integer width and height in physical pixels, within the declared limits.
actions.scroll: Scroll the panel to position start or end, with animations disabled. Requires a nonempty panel and actual scrollable content at execution.

execution: Each iteration launches a fresh app process. The measured region starts after the window is loaded.
initialButtonCount is setup outside the measured region. Use zero unless the request explicitly requires a prepopulated panel.
Steps execute in order on the UI thread, with layout/dispatcher settling and per-step correctness checks.
Every scenario is measured ten times. The user reviews the generated plan before starting preparation.
Capture reports layout counts and scenario duration; it does not measure presented frames, CPU stacks, memory or app-launch latency.
Custom scenarios are measurement/investigation-only in this milestone, not governed fix-acceptance tests.
unsupported: Clicking or typing, navigation, dialogs, file/network access, other controls or apps, arbitrary code and shell commands.
Launch-time measurements, arbitrary waits, loops, randomness, changing iteration count or changing performance budgets.
A request with unspecified necessary counts, dimensions or scroll positions must return NeedsClarification.
